sourceRefs.quote: Datenbankmodelle unterscheiden, Daten organisieren und speichern sowie Abfragen erstellen
An SQL SELECT statement is used to do this.

sections.title: Grundlagen
sections.content: SELECT-Abfragen lesen Daten aus Tabellen. Eine WHERE-Klausel legt fest, welche Zeilen zurückgegeben werden.

sourceRefs.quote: An SQL SELECT statement is used to do this.
A query can be “qualified” by adding a WHERE clause that specifies which rows are wanted.

sections.title: JOINs
sections.content: Join-Abfragen greifen auf mehrere Tabellen zu und kombinieren Zeilen anhand eines Ausdrucks, der festlegt, welche Zeilen zusammengehören.

sourceRefs.quote: Queries that access multiple tables (or multiple instances of the same table) at one time are called join queries.
They combine rows from one table with rows from a second table, with an expression specifying which rows are to be paired.

sections.title: Fazit
sections.content: SELECT und WHERE bestimmen Ausgabespalten und Zeilenfilter. JOIN-Abfragen kombinieren Zeilen aus mehreren Tabellen anhand eines Paarungsausdrucks.

sourceRefs.quote: A query can be “qualified” by adding a WHERE clause that specifies which rows are wanted.
They combine rows from one table with rows from a second table, with an expression specifying which rows are to be paired.
